title: Injectivity of the differential on tangent spaces is equivalent to unramifiedness at a point with equal residue fields
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a morphism f: X to Y of schemes locally of finite type over a base S, a point x with y = f(x) and equal residue fields, the lemma shows that injectivity of the differential on tangent spaces is equivalent to unramifiedness of f at x (statement lines 3148-3157). The proof is a short chain of translations: the differential is injective exactly when the induced map on the fibres of the relative differentials is surjective, which is the tangent-cotangent duality statement; the transitivity exact sequence for differentials then identifies that surjectivity with the vanishing of the fibre of the relative differentials of f; and vanishing of that fibre is the pointwise criterion for unramifiedness (proof lines 3159-3170). The claim is H2: three cited inputs chained, but the chain is what produces a usable tangent-space criterion, and each step is a different statement rather than a repetition.
